notes: Makes the caution on an irregularly-celebrated Mass explicit instead of implied. Previously Notre-Dame-du-Grand-Pouvoir Cap-Malheureux showed only a generic lower-confidence line, and the diocese actual words - that the Mass is not regular and people should confirm with the parish first - were stored but never displayed. Adds a controlled advisory field, deliberately separate from context_note, which holds internal editorial notes that must never be shown to users. The card, the detail sheet and the saved-church card now carry a red banner reading, in the user language: The diocese states that this Mass is not held regularly - please confirm with the parish before travelling. Only one row currently carries it.
